effects.authorship: codex-rpc original pixel effects, not OpenAI source artwork
effects.policy: Non-typing poses translate at integer coordinates without cropping, with FX in alpha zero transparent space. Laptop typing scenes hold the original pose fixed outside x67..103,y144..172 and articulate sampled paw pixels above a reconstructed keyboard/chest underlay; the face, body outline, feet and laptop remain unchanged before palette quantization

articulation.interpolation: Continuous sinusoidal paw presses sampled every 50ms; base pose and laptop remain fixed
